title: Has both perks and quirks- be sure it fits your need!
text:
Has both perks and quirks- be sure it fits your need!. A brushed nickel toilet bowl cleaner that hides the dirty ugly stuff in the bathroom- let’s face it, out of sight/out of mind is such a better option when it comes to toilet bowl cleaning! With a hinged flip top lid- this keeps the aesthetics in any bath or powder room looking far nicer then the alternative. However, the lid can be fickle which needs one to physically “click open” with their hand.. Uhh, yuck!!

As for the brush: Cleaning wand connects easily by the 2 ends with pre-made grooves that simply screw together to connect handle and brush. **Be sure to attach this tight!! I found while cleaning in a circular motion the brush can unscrew the two connective pieces.. Yuck again!! To avoid brush head falling off in the most inopportune moment- be sure connections are truly tightly fastened!!!

Bristles provide good scrubbing capacity- and although head doesn’t angle or bend.. it sort of shape-shifts to reach underneath the rim. I find the stronger bristles provide a more thorough scrub leaving things feeling far cleaner then the silicone alternative. One potential issue may be the length of wand itself! Since toilets can vary size and shape…you may find if your toilet is larger then basic/standard (mine is!) wand can be a tad short leaving you to maneuver brush with your hand breaching in past the rim of the bowl.. Something easily remedied an extra few inches of handle length were provided..

Overall, a $15 solution for an “out of sight/mind” aesthetic for a bathroom.. it has a few quirks that could improve making it universal. As is- just be sure the length for toilet bowl won’t be a concern! Hoping info helps your decision- Be stay safe everyone.
